title: Masterni
overview: A girl goes missing, leaving the nation in shock as every lead goes cold.

title: Toronto Apartment
overview: After being dumped, a Toronto man subleases his apartment for an hour or two at a time to make rent as a 'community space.'

title: The Invisibles
overview: The story follows a family of five, living quietly and away from prying eyes on the Izu Islands—including the youngest daughter, born invisible. Their mother, who had raised her cheerfully, has passed away from illness, and their anxious father has devoted himself to hiding his daughters from the world. One day, however, they must set out on a journey to visit their grandmother, a famous actress living in Tokyo.

title: Lives at Right Angles
overview: Daiki has autism spectrum disorder, and his sister Nozomi has supported him since childhood. Having lost their mother at a young age, the siblings distanced themselves from their neglectful father and have lived their lives diligently together

title: The Brightest Sun
overview: When a private detective is murdered, a former colleague and a trainee detective are sent to investigate. Along the way, they uncover a tragic truth that triggers memories from their own haunted pasts.

title: Once More
overview: Raghu, a man caught up with a deep hold of grief comes across Anjali, who is spinning everything in her capacity to win him over. The love you gave away always comes back they say. In one way or other. Sometimes from a different human. This is a story of love coming back into the life of someone who doesn’t want to take it. A tale of second chances.. happy healing and bitter sweet closures.

title: The Sun Never Sets
overview: Wendy’s life is thrown into chaos when her boyfriend, Jack, who is older and divorced with children, insists they take space to evaluate the relationship. During their break, Wendy runs into her ex, Chuck, forcing them into a volatile triangle.

title: Barreda
overview: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

title: Rise of the Footsoldier: Retribution
overview: Tate (Craig Fairbrass) battles ruthless mercenaries throughout Ibiza as he avenges his friend's death.  Get ready for the biggest and most action packed film in the successful independent crime saga.

title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
original_title: 劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ〈ワルプルギスの廻天〉
overview: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.

title: Bagong tukso 2
overview: Meet the newest faces setting VMX on fire. Angel Castro, Shalanie De Vera, Shannon Sizon, Kim Yashii, and Akira Takamura turn up the heat in this all-new VMX Special. Get to know the women everyone's talking about and discover what makes them the newest VMX craze.

title: Django Unchained
overview: With the help of a German bounty hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.

title: Creeping Weaved Farms
overview: Series of Collision weaved together to form Adam.

title: No Handouts
overview: In a hyper-capitalistic future, rookie EMT Joanna Broz finds herself in a struggle between job security and an Innocent boy's life.

title: Escape from the Deadly Town
overview: In the desolate village with dilapidated houses, dead trees, and gloomy winds, a revenge kidnapping unfolds. All this is actually a bloodshed caused by an astonishing scam. Wang Yantao, whose family is destroyed, is bent on killing the enemy with his own hands. In the house an interrogation goes on, in the unfinished building hides a huge sum of stolen money, and former accomplices turn against each other. When Wang raises his butcher's knife, who will get out unscathed in the dark? The media's dark secrets will be unveiled in horror.

title: Deadly Sign-In
overview: When recorded audio from a murder starts playing on the speakers from an unknown device, Kate doesn’t know if it’s real or a prank.

title: Confinement
overview: Pregnant and recently widowed, Stella is taken in by her late husband’s estranged family. But beneath their generosity lies something deeply unsettling, leaving Stella fighting for her life as their obsession with her unborn child turns deadly.

title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
overview: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

title: Sua's Home
overview: 15-year-old Young-sun, abandoned by her adoptive parents and left with nowhere to go, temporarily stays at the home of Sua, whom she met as a tennis training partner. Young-sun, wanting to stay at Sua's house for a long time, tries hard to become part of the family, but Sua and her family find Young-sun burdensome.

title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table - 44: CLOUDY BEACH
original_title: 死亡遊戯で飯を食う。 44:CLOUDY BEACH
overview: Overcoming the jinx known as the "Thirty Game Wall," which drastically reduces the survival rate of players, Yuuki continues her journey. A game where death is always close at hand. Next, she takes on a remote island in the middle of the ocean. Eight players have gathered there. Among them are seasoned veterans whom Yuuki knows. The game is "Cloudy Beach." Beyond the wall, only those who have crossed the wall remain. Today, once again, she makes a living playing deadly games.

title: Miguel Ángel Blanco: The 48 Hours That Changed Spain
original_title: Miguel Ángel Blanco: Las 48 horas que lo cambiaron todo
overview: This documentary explores how Miguel Ángel Blanco's 1997 abduction turned fear into collective resistance and shaped Spain's fright Against ETA terrorism.

title: O Little Christmas Market
overview: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

title: Baby Doe
overview: At 22, Gail gave birth alone and left her newborn in the woods. Decades later, she's arrested for murder, despite claiming the baby was stillborn. This documentary explores the fallout when young women cannot accept the reality of an unplanned pregnancy.

title: The One Next Door
overview: When a mysterious stranger moves in next door to Robert and Tabitha, boundaries are tested, loyalty is questioned, and danger comes for all.

title: Haciendo amigos
overview: Antonio and Félix, small-time thieves fleeing police after a jewelry heist, meet Eva, a theater group monitor. She mistakes Félix for Ángel, a new member. They use the confusion to hide, unaware they'll spend a week with the group.

title: Léon : Au-delà de l’Or
overview: For one year, Léon Marchand allows cameras to follow him through competitions, studies, family life, and growing fame. Through an intimate perspective, the documentary reveals the man behind the champion as he searches for purpose after achieving so much at such a young age.

title: Portrait of a Family
overview: Baseball player Jung-gu and movie star Nam-mi are a celebrity couple who are blissfully happy in their careers and marriage. One day, a girl named Dong-ju shows up and the couple's lives are instantly destroyed. Seven years later, as Dong-ju gets involved in the death of a middle-school girl, Jung-gu and Nam-mi decide to fight a battle they have no chance of winning.

title: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
overview: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.

title: Dread
overview: Terror takes many forms. In five chilling tales, the mundane becomes monstrous and no one gets out clean.

title: Sonali Danar Shankhachil
overview: On the evening of their wedding anniversary, Anuradha prepares chai and firni for two; a quiet ritual she holds sacred every year. In the warmth of their drawing room, she and her husband Abhishek revisit the small, luminous moments of eight years lived together. It is a night of memory, laughter, and unspoken grief; and the tender, impossible weight of a love that refuses to let go.

title: Mayday
overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

title: Ketticè
overview: Palermo, 2012. Giulio, a listless and dissatisfied 16-year-old, drifts through his days with no enthusiasm for school and no prospects for the future. His encounter with Ketty, a more self-assured peer, offers him an escape from the monotony.

title: Time Was No Longer Patient
overview: After his high school play ends, a senior student faces his biggest fear: the realization that no amount of regret can make up for wasted Time.

title: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
original_title: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
overview: The surviving Resistance faces the First Order once again as the journey of Rey, Finn and Poe Dameron continues. With the power and knowledge of generations behind them, the final battle begins.

title: Divergent
overview: In a world divided into factions based on personality types, Tris learns that she's been classified as Divergent and won't fit in. When she discovers a plot to destroy Divergents, Tris and the mysterious Four must find out what makes Divergents dangerous before it's too late.

title: Infiltrate
overview: In a city overrun by crime, government Agent Lily Chen is forced to choose between her duty and her family when her husband is kidnapped, and she’s blackmailed into assassinating high-level criminals to save him. As she delves deeper into the criminal underworld, Lily’s relentless pursuit of justice unravels a web of corruption, leading to a final, life-altering decision that will change her world forever.

title: Mockbuster
overview: A struggling filmmaker’s opportunity collides with chaos and compromise when Sharknado’s notorious studio, The Asylum, invites him to direct a "mockbuster."

title: Night Nurse
overview: As a series of perverse scam calls unsettles an idyllic retirement community, a starry-eyed nurse becomes entangled with her mysterious patient.

title: Barrio Triste
overview: On the outskirts of Medellín, Colombia in the late 1980s, local residents report strange lights descending from the sky. When a reporter arrives to investigate, a ragtag group of teens from a lawless neighbourhood storm the scene and steal his camera. In the hands of its new owners, the device records a mesmerising plunge into their frantic existence.

title: Clash of the Thundermans
overview: When Chloe develops a destructive new superpower, the Hero League orders her to an elite boarding school for superheroes to learn control of her abilities. Faced with the prospect of sending Chloe away for years, the Thundermans split apart, with Phoebe, Barb and Billy taking her into hiding. Max, Hank, and Nora track their rogue family members, until the two factions face off against each other in a full-on battle for the Thundermans’ future.

title: Lomu
overview: A Tongan/Kiwi warrior who could run 100 metres in under 11 seconds. He was the youngest All Black to put on the jersey and still holds the record for the most tries scored in World Cup history.

title: My Best Friend
overview: The film will talk about women redefining their lives at 50, covering topics such as menopause, changing professions and separation.

title: By Any Means
overview: A young Black FBI agent is sent into 1960s Mississippi to investigate a wave of brutal killings targeting civil rights leaders. Forced to work alongside notorious mafia hitman Greg Scarpa, he finds himself pulled into a deadly hunt where justice and vengeance begin to blur.

title: Мой папа — медведь 2
overview: A grown-up Masha decides to arrange a personal life for her father, Misha, which leads to a fight with her father, who pries into matters that don't concern her. Masha, upset with her father, runs away into the forest and ends up with a little bear cub whose parents were kidnapped by poachers. Masha's adventures begin, during which she realizes how difficult it is to be a parent, and most importantly, how difficult it is to raise children.

title: Tikus!
overview: A group of people are marooned at an isolated wellness retreat because of floods. One by one each of them gets killed as it's slowly revealed there is a murderer among them.

title: Munafik: Melawan Iblis
overview: Adam, a religious teacher who stopped performing ruqyah after losing his wife, is asked to save Fitri, who is being terrorized by supernatural forces. When he resumes performing ruqyah, he uncovers a dark secret behind Fitri's terror.

title: Same Sun - Mit dem Fahrrad durch Afrika
original_title: Same Sun - Mit dem Fahrrad durch Afrika
overview: The film SAME SUN tells the story of Wiebke Lühmann's journey from Freiburg to the Cape of Good Hope. Honest, raw, and close to the inner and outer challenges of a 430-day bicycle trip. Her journey takes her through 22 countries, Sahara storms, the rain season, the Congo Basin, and the deserts of Namibia.

title: Where the Waves Took Her
overview: For many, crossing the Mediterranean is their last hope of escaping war, persecution, and hunger. As more and more women are forced to take this deadly route, a midwife is now a permanent member of the crew of a sea rescue ship. While midwife Anne-Katrin takes part in her first mission, survivors recount the horrors of their journey. Their worlds briefly collide before the rescued women step into another uncertain future.

title: La chaleur
overview: It’s unusually hot on the beaches of the Landes, and 17-year-old Marouane is spending his last day at the campground with a nagging fear: will the body he buried on the beach the day before be discovered? Marouane also wonders if he might be falling in love with the charming Giulia.

title: Pacific
overview: A group of young travelers are stranded on an island in the Pacific where they struggle to escape an evil presence kept hidden from mankind for centuries.

title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
original_title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
overview: Small-town Kansas hairdresser Gail Daughtry's fiancé uses his 'celebrity sex pass' on Jennifer Aniston, prompting Gail to travel to LA with her friend Otto to find her own pass, Jon Hamm, to even the score.

title: Operation Cronos
overview: Based on real events, chronicles the relentless pursuit of the terrorists responsible for the horrific Barcelona attacks. With a high-stakes countdown, the film dives into the race against time from the perspective of elite state security forces, as they work tirelessly to capture those behind the tragic events in Las Ramblas on August 17, 2017.

title: Kaka Jamm Peya
overview: Kaka, branded as a curse since birth by his fellow villagers goes on to win a lottery ticket. And that changes everyone's behaviour towards him. But there's a twist in the story which only Kaka knows.

title: Numakage Public Pool
overview: For over five decades, a beloved Tokyo suburban pool affectionately called “the ocean” offered health, joy, and belonging to elderly swimmers, families, and the local gay community. But when urban development forces its demolition, a wave of grief sweeps through those who called it home.  Through powerful, intimate moments, this deeply human story explores loss not tied to death, but to place, memory, and identity. Guided by the five stages of grief, director Ota invites us to reflect on what it means to say goodbye not just to a building, but to a vital space of connection, healing, and shared life.

title: Backrooms Bigfoot
overview: Two strangers wake up, trapped in the endless backrooms and are hunted by a massive supernatural Bigfoot creature lurking in the maze. As reality breaks around them, they must fight to survive and find a way out before it kills them.

title: The Leaching
overview: After waking up on her father's isolated forest property with amnesia, Vivian must use her limited memory to piece together the nightmarish truth, all the while being tormented by the undead, a giant leech monster, and her "father."

title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Prelude to a Wedding
original_title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Prelude to a Wedding
overview: When Gethsemane is invited to play at a wedding, she and Eamon find themselves involved in the death of a member of the bridal party.

title: Farm House
overview: House sitting can be relaxing, peaceful and refreshing, but terror is here to stay. This Warren County Serial Killings Cases is just one of the most perplexing and tragic chapters in the recent American criminal history.

title: Summer Sparks
overview: Follows a single father and a single mom at Camp Evergreen during a summer cook-off, where cooking mishaps and heartfelt moments lead to an unexpected romantic connection.

title: Home A Loan
overview: A tenacious mother Eun-jin forces her family to move into a rundown apartment, hoping for a luxurious rebuild. However, she loses her sanity as her plan fails and becomes harmful to those who she vowed to protect.

title: 25 Cats from Qatar
overview: The nation of Qatar has a street cat population equal to the entire human population of the entire country – and is growing fast. Disease is rampant, and local adoption is rare. 25 CATS FROM QATAR follows one mission – led by a network of multinational underground animal rescuers in Doha and a Milwaukee flight attendant/ cat cafe owner – to transport out 25 lucky felines and find homes for them abroad, all the while searching for a long-term solution to the crisis.

title: The Echo Chamber
overview: Leo and Ava chase each other—coming close, drifting apart, and searching for their way back. They cannot let go, nor break free. Through the rooms, Ava’s voice echoes across time, carrying to the surface what endures—and what can no longer be held back.

title: One Piece Heroines
overview: After failing to stop the thieves due to ill-fitting shoes, Nami storms into the shop where she bought them for a refund. However, the head designer offers to make her a new pair from scratch on one condition: she must walk in their upcoming fashion show.

title: Haunted House
overview: Song Hui secretly takes shelter in a haunted house, encountering a series of supernatural phenomena. As she uncovers the terrifying truth of the house, she embarks on a thrilling journey intertwined with trauma and protection.

title: Rocky II
overview: After Rocky goes the distance with champ Apollo Creed, both try to put the fight behind them and move on. Rocky settles down with Adrian but can't put his life together outside the ring, while Creed seeks a rematch to restore his reputation. Soon enough, the "Master of Disaster" and the "Italian Stallion" are set on a collision course for a climactic battle that is brutal and unforgettable.

title: The Last Picture Shows
overview: Ten states. 10,825 miles. 123 theaters. In his latest feature The Last Picture Shows, filmmaker Rustin Thompson journeys into the American West on a search for traces of what was once a center of small-town life: the movie theater. On the trip, he finds long abandoned and forgotten cinemas; movie houses that have fallen into disrepair; theaters recently closed, theaters struggling to hold on, and theaters that—thanks to their thoughtful caretakers—are not only surviving but thriving. Between the stops along the way, Rustin poetically intersperses excerpts from Peter Bogdanovich’s 1971 classic film The Last Picture Show, as well as reflections on past and present hardships facing the film exhibition industry. The Last Picture Shows reminds viewers that even in vast cinema deserts, there are oases of community and gathering that remain, where the movie house continues to be a place of wonder, contemplation, and connection.

title: Le miracle
overview: After Angelica is disturbed by her adult son Mattia in her relaxation bath, she is finally able to let go. She begins to masturbate in front of the poster of footballer Valenti, her son's idol. Suddenly, Valenti's gaze fixes on her… a cry for help. An absurd euphoria spreads: the miracle crystallises into a struggle for power and intimacy between mother and son.

title: Unidentified Murder
overview: Alien Alert!!! An influencer couple staged a harmless prank in pursuit of clicks and likes. Little do they know, their little escapade has gone out of control and spiraled into a real tragedy. A series of accidents, followed by blackmails and Extraterrestrial Encounters somehow echo and unveil the myth of a myterious child disappearnace 25 years ago! A group of five, a chain of bizzare events, layers of schemes and plot twists. It's all-you-can-experience in One Crazy Night!

title: Break Time
overview: Kyung-jun receives an offer from his old orphanage buddy, Jae-hyun, to rob a local soup joint that "only takes cash." What they thought would be an easy score takes a wildly unexpected turn with the sudden arrival of one man.

title: Niko
overview: In the troubled night of Seoul on the verge of apocalypse, Niko, a penniless scriptwriter, works a part-time job as a companion for people who have lost their keys. When she can no longer satisfy her longing for true love in this once melancholic, sensual, and bustling city, she disappears. Her boyfriend Jeremy and their new friend Ji-eun start looking for the missing Niko and become entangled in a love triangle. At last, Niko finds a new, reckless, and ultimate way to express her feelings.

title: Company
overview: A mysterious traveler tells a story that spans generations, drawing together the lives of three wounded souls struggling to choose between vengeance and forgiveness.

title: The Noise I Keep
overview: A lightning storm shot on May 19th, 2025, entirely on iPhone.

title: A Woman's Life
overview: Gabrielle, a dedicated surgeon and head of a hospital department, is stretched thin by the weight of responsibility. There is little time left for her private life: a loving husband and a mother who depends on her care. Yet this is the life she wanted, the life she chose. When a novelist comes to observe her at work for a book, her balance begins to shift.

title: Superman
overview: Mild-mannered Clark Kent works as a reporter at the Daily Planet alongside his crush, Lois Lane. Clark must summon his superhero alter-ego when the nefarious Lex Luthor launches a plan to take over the world.

title: Two Pids
overview: After the world premiere of Being John Smith at the Toronto Film Festival a strange experience in the filmmaker’s hotel causes him to ponder the nature of reality.

title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity The Fool
original_title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity The Fool
overview: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

title: Purgatory: Zone of Murderers
overview: In the near future of South Korea, where it became lawless due to an economic crisis, a new authoritarian government implements the “Permanent Exile Law” to easily control the country. According to this law, death row inmates are permanently exiled to a detention center, the Purgatory, built in abandoned nuclear power plants. With a degree of self-governance granted by the government, the Purgatory gradually reaches a point where it is beyond external control, leaving the government struggling to find a solution. Yu-seong, a police officer who became a death row inmate due to the revenge for his daughter and wife, is offered a deal by the Director of NIS. Now Yu-seong must eliminate the Purgatory Boss, the king of the center, in exchange for possible pardon.

title: hololive English 4th Concert - Serendipity - Day 1
overview: Day 1 of hololive English's fourth concert, held on July 3, 2026 at Shine Auditorium in Los Angeles, in select theaters worldwide, and streamed online via Streaming+ and SPWN.

title: Queen Omega @ Summerjam Festival 2026
overview: Reggae, dancehall, afrobeats and good vibes: Summerjam celebrates Caribbean rhythms and sounds from all over the world! Every summer, the festival offers a rich and varied programme on the shores of Lake Fühlinger See, near Cologne, Germany. An unmissable European event for all reggae fans.

title: Drifter
overview: In a forgotten desert town, a solitary racetrack janitor with a gift for drifting is haunted by his tragic past. Given a single chance to compete at a pro drifting event, he discovers his raw talent is useless without the one thing he's always avoided: connection with others. Under a hardened mentor, he must learn to trust his found family and transform his untamed, lonely art into a dangerous dance of partnership, or be consumed and controlled by the past he's desperate to escape.

title: Summer's Last Resort
overview: Determined to save her mom from another bad relationship, a teen accidentally turns a luxury vacation into total chaos.

title: I Was a Teenage Sex Pistol
original_title: I Was a Teenage Sex Pistol
overview: Experience the Pistols' rise to global infamy with an honest, insightful account of a group of malcontents, determined to change the music business and to attack hypocrisy and stale conventions in society at large. Based off the novel written by Glen Matlock, one of the founding members of the Sex Pistols who co-wrote ten of twelve iconic songs on their only studio album, NEVER MIND THE BOLLOCKS. Glen describes in detail the mindset of the UK in the early 70's and divulges a mine of information; Steve's thievery, Wally Nightingale, the search for a singer, the exploding punk scene and a bleak backdrop providing a contrast to the excitement and energy of McLaren's shop. The public will now have a chance to hear the story, not just from a member of the band, but also from a man who had his contributions exceptionally downplayed.

title: Baby Do Die Do
overview: A deaf and mute serial killer in Mumbai can only hear her dead sister's voice as she commits murders for mysterious reasons.

title: Call My Agent! The Movie
overview: Five years after the series finale, Andréa Martel is now a director on her first film. Things, however, are not running smoothly. When her lead actor drops days before cameras are set to roll, she must get the team back together, rekindling all the old friendships and rivalries.

title: Jurassic World Dominion
overview: Four years after Isla Nublar was destroyed, dinosaurs now live—and hunt—alongside humans all over the world. This fragile balance will reshape the future and determine, once and for all, whether human beings are to remain the apex predators on a planet they now share with history's most fearsome creatures.

title: Keep Real
overview: Thirty years ago, the Super Ying Association led by Superman Wang Changhai crushed the aliens. Years later, Wang Changhai was appointed to return to his hometown to set up a combat squad, but in the town of Rheinland, which had been peaceful for many years, human feelings and courtesies have left Wang Changhai overwhelmed, creating layers of obstacles to Wang's ability to complete his mission.

title: Al Murray: All You Need Is Guv
original_title: Al Murray: All You Need Is Guv
overview: With a fresh and frothing pint to hand, a barrel of laughs to pour from, and a flower in his heart, Guv is all you need.

title: Masao Adachi Takes a Passport Photo
original_title: 足立正生、パスポート写真を撮る
overview: A deeply personal portrait of one of the most enigmatic and influential figures in Japanese cinema: filmmaker, writer, and revolutionary Masao Adachi.

title: Being Heumann
overview: In 1977, Judy Heumann leads over a hundred disabled people to take over the San Francisco Federal Building, kicking off a 28-day sit-in.

title: Mulan
overview: When Imperial China calls one man from every family to defend the empire from invading Huns, a young woman disguises herself as a soldier to take her ailing father’s place. Facing ruthless invaders, brutal training, and the risk of execution if discovered, she must decide who she truly is— and what she’s willing to fight for.

title: Jangan Lupa Bahagia
overview: Ulla (Alghifahri Jasin) must become the backbone for her two younger siblings, Imma (Jasmin Risach) and Ikbal (M Aqif Difullah), after their parents pass away. They are staying in an empty house owned by their father’s best friend. Ulla is determined to keep her two younger siblings in school to fulfill the dreams of their late parents. To make ends meet, Ulla works hard as an online motorcycle taxi driver. But a setback occurs when her cell phone—her primary tool for work—is severely damaged after falling and being run over by a motorcycle. At the same time, they are forced to leave the house where they’ve been staying because the homeowner’s child has decided to sell it.

title: The Fix
overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

title: Emperor
overview: After taking a deserted Moscow, Napoleon occupies the Kremlin, where his loyal General Michel Clément, a descendant of a Russian boyar who came to Russia believing in the justice of Napoleon's campaign, constantly stands by his side. Meanwhile, the monks of the Chudov Monastery plot to assassinate the emperor by mining the Arsenal, and the young noblewoman Maria, seeking revenge for her dead brother, attempts to shoot Napoleon. The failed assassination attempt brings her into contact with Michel and the Polish officer Józef Sadok. Disguised as an actress in the monastery, Maria finds herself drawn into a dangerous game where rescue, suspicion, and a budding bond with Michel gradually change the fates of all involved.

title: Mr. Nelson, Did You Kill People?
original_title: ネルソンさん、あなたは人を殺しましたか?
overview: Vietnam veteran Allen Nelson returns with severe PTSD, winding up on the streets before crossing paths with Dr. Daniels of the Veterans Affairs who sets about trying to help him.

title: Polymer
overview: A cuck smokes a cigarette backwards while a failed rapper reminisces on his downfall. They come to realize a startling existential truth.

title: The Goonies
overview: Young teen Mikey Walsh and his friends set off on a quest to find Pirate One-Eyed Willie's treasure in hopes of saving their homes from demolition. However, on their quest to find the treasure, they run into a family of recently escaped criminals, determined to capture the kids and reach the treasure first.

title: The Remotes
overview: A grieving detective finds himself increasingly ensnared while investigating a case involving a sinister navigation app causing physical and psychological debris.

title: Há Sinais
overview: Marcelo, a deaf and LGBTQIAPN+ youth grieving the loss of his father, finds in a theater group with young deaf artists a possible path to transform his pain. Communicated entirely in Brazilian Sign Language (LIBRAS) and conceived from an aesthetic that prioritizes accessibility.

title: Hibla 2
overview: Two VMX queens, Aliya Raymundo and Margaret Diaz, play reunited childhood friends who share a memorable past and a complicated present: one is a liberated city girl, the other a sheltered country virgin, and both are surrounded by men eager to get a taste of their youth.

title: Verónica
overview: In the midst of gender transition, Verónica runs away from home in search of a new beginning and finds refuge with her cousin Alex. As she navigates her new life, actress Israel, who plays Verónica, faces her own personal journey during filming.

title: Strawberry Fields Forever
original_title: Un champ de fraises pour l’éternité
overview: The year-round residents in a lakeside campsite have to leave because of a sale.

title: They Took My Daugther
overview: When her daughter goes missing and kidnapped into a world of high-class corruption - a dishonorably discharged mom stops at nothing to find her.

title: Tavvai
overview: In 1880, A Maharaj through his atrocities invited Tavvai. The village is terrified for generations until a chosen one sets things right.

title: Paprika
overview: Dr. Atsuko Chiba is a research psychologist who uses a device called the DC Mini to enter her patients' dreams, wherein she adopts the alter-ego "Paprika". When the device is stolen, she must stop rogue elements from merging the dream and waking worlds.

title: Pavers
overview: Les Pavés follows a street photographer wandering through Brussels, where unexpected encounters with homeless people lead him into intimate conversations. As he tries to preserve fleeting moments through his camera, he is forced to confront the inevitability of disappearance.

title: Very Deep Inside
overview: A gay couple from a small town travels to Mexico City for a weekend to celebrate one of their thirtythird birthdays. What begins as an intimate getaway soon transforms into a journey of temptation. Desire, curiosity, and discomfort push them to confront what they have avoided for years, inviting them to cross boundaries they once believed were clearly defined. In the midst of the vast metropolis, their bond begins to unravel as buried desires surface, forcing them to confront whether love can survive the weight of everything left unsaid.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 2
overview: After settling in Green Hills, Sonic is eager to prove he has what it takes to be a true hero. His test comes when Dr. Robotnik returns, this time with a new partner, Knuckles, in search for an emerald that has the power to destroy civilizations. Sonic teams up with his own sidekick, Tails, and together they embark on a globe-trotting journey to find the emerald before it falls into the wrong hands.

title: AEW x NJPW x CMLL x Stardom Present Forbidden Door 2026: Buy-In
original_title: AEW x NJPW x CMLL x Stardom Present Forbidden Door 2026: Buy-In
overview: The Buy-In served as the pre-show for All Elite Wrestling's 2026 Forbidden Door event.

title: Hôtel Terminus
overview: December 31. The concierge of a luxurious seaside hotel deals with the guests' reactions after they learn about the imminent threat of a nuclear war.

title: Empty Places
overview: Four friends convene at a café and engage in a peculiar game entitled "Empty Space". Thereafter, their paths diverge for a prolonged period. Each endeavours to find self-realisation through various forms of creative activity, seeking to impose their minor and superfluous art upon a vast and indifferent world.

title: The Confession
overview: As a priest listens to a distraught woman’s confession, he begins to realise she’s after more than forgiveness.

title: WWE Night of Champions 2026
overview: The 2026 Night of Champions, also promoted as Night of Champions: Riyadh, was a professional wrestling premium live event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) that took place on June 27, 2026, at Kingdom Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The event featured the finals of the 2026 King and Queen of the Ring tournaments, along with championship matches for the WWE United States Championship and WWE Women's United States Championship. It was headlined by an Undisputed WWE Championship Triple Threat match between champion Cody Rhodes, Sami Zayn, and Gunther.

title: Gator Face
overview: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

title: Stan Lee: The Final Chapter
overview: An insider look at Stan Lee's tumultuous final years, revealing how mistreatment and conflict threatened his life and legacy.

title: A Castle of Our Own
overview: When an overworked architect takes an unexpected summer trip, a sandcastle contest and a contractor help her reconnect with her daughter, rediscover joy, and find love she never saw coming.

title: Space Coast Confidential
overview: A veteran detective is paired with a transplant detective from Massachusetts to investigate strange occurrences in Cocoa Beach.

title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
original_title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
overview: Harry, Ron and Hermione walk away from their last year at Hogwarts to find and destroy the remaining Horcruxes, putting an end to Voldemort's bid for immortality. But with Harry's beloved Dumbledore dead and Voldemort's unscrupulous Death Eaters on the loose, the world is more dangerous than ever.

title: Sinsin and the Mouse
original_title: シンシン アンド ザ マウス SINSIN AND THE MOUSE
overview: A young Japanese woman, who is reeling from the death of her much loved mother, decides to take a trip to Taiwanese capital Taipei to try to alleviate her loss. While there, an encounter with a young man sees the pair strike up a tentative friendship that could help her come to terms with the death.

title: Brian; or, Brain
overview: Brian has learned something very interesting about the world.

title: Alien Spa
overview: Three siblings, grieving the death of their parents, have a spa day from hell (or shall we say... from space).

title: Viaje al país de los blancos
original_title: Viaje al país de los blancos

title: The Weight
overview: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

title: The Sign of the Dragon
overview: Detective Michael loses his hearing during an operation and subsequently withdraws from active duty. Years later, a former colleague asks him to take on a mysterious case involving a dangerous dragon cult. Despite his limitations, he is called back into action and must confront his past in order to solve the case.

title: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie
overview: On the morning of his hundredth birthday, Fanny finds her grandfather dead in his bed. As she and her family are forced to deal with the death, a bitter dispute over the inheritance erupts, in which old power relations are reversed.

title: Tanah Sengketa
overview: Yuni, a research student, opens a free learning class for children in Kampung Degong. Raka, a local youth who supports her, provides some needed books for the children. Terror begins to haunt Yuni. Despite warnings, Yuni refuses to give up and seeks to uncover the truth behind the strangeness.

title: Adam’s Eight
overview: Adam's Eight tells the remarkable true story of Karl Adam — a visionary rowing coach who, in 1950s Germany, brought together a group of underdogs and turned them into champions. Within just three years, his team defied all odds and won Olympic gold in Rome in 1960.

title: The Djinn's Curse 2
overview: In a village at the foot of Mount Budo, Diana begins behaving violently after disappearing into the forest, forcing her husband Anas to kill her.

title: The City of the Living
overview: Luca is twenty-three years old. He lives with an adoptive family who loves him. He moves between the suburbs and the city center with his friends and has a girlfriend with whom he shares a love that is young, yet significant for them both. Luca is searching for his path at an age when everything still feels possible and, at the same time, already lost; in this pursuit, he leads a double life. One night, after a seemingly chance encounter, the trajectory of Luca’s life is shattered, colliding with blind and senseless violence.

title: Und es war Sommer - Dieter Thomas Kuhn & Band
original_title: Und es war Sommer - Dieter Thomas Kuhn & Band

title: National Theatre Live: Les Liaisons Dangereuses
original_title: National Theatre Live: Les Liaisons Dangereuses
overview: A new staging of Christopher Hampton's celebrated adaptation of the classic novel, where among the glittering salons of the super-rich, one misstep can mean ruin. Marquise de Merteuil is a master in the art of survival. Alongside the magnetic Vicomte de Valmont, they turn seduction into strategy and weaponise desire. But when their alliance collapses into rivalry, the battle between them threatens to destroy everyone in their path. Filmed live at the National Theatre, Marianne Elliott directs this thrilling game of love, lies, and social warfare.

title: You Had to Be There: How the Toronto Godspell Ignited the Comedy Revolution...
original_title: You Had to Be There: How the Toronto Godspell Ignited the Comedy Revolution...
overview: Martin Short, Eugene Levy, Gilda Radner, Victor Garber, Paul Shaffer, and other entertainment icons got their start in a 1972 Toronto production of the musical Godspell. Featuring interviews with the surviving cast members, Lin-Manuel Miranda, Mike Myers, and more, the film recounts a pivotal moment in comedy history, in hilarious, moving, and inspiring detail. Executive produced by Judd Apatow.

title: After-School Exorcism Club: Girls' Night
overview: At Palja Girls' High School, where ominous energy seems to be part of the curriculum, strange incidents unfold one after another. The principal secretly recruits five girls whose fates are perfectly aligned, tasking them with a mission to exorcise ghosts haunting the school. After 30 years, the After-School Exorcism Club of Palja Girls' High returns!

title: Jangan Buang Ibu
overview: Ristiana, a single mother, struggles to raise her three children after her husband left her with significant debt. Her decisions strain her relationship with her children. Despite the distance and longing, her three children remain devoted to their mother and strive to repair their relationship before it's too late.

title: Satoko Always
overview: Satoko is a 15-year-old junior high school student. After a brief encounter with herclassmate Hayase at the ENT clinic, she begins to write a story sparked by herfeelings for him. Satoko is a 35-year-old working at a film publicity company. After being stabbed bythe wife of her married lover and hospitalized, she starts writing a story. Satoko is a 55-year-old housewife. On the last day of making lunchboxes for herthree sons, she remembers her childhood dream of becoming a writer and beginsto write.

title: Frozen
overview: Young princess Anna of Arendelle dreams about finding true love at her sister Elsa’s coronation. Fate takes her on a dangerous journey in an attempt to end the eternal winter that has fallen over the kingdom. She's accompanied by ice delivery man Kristoff, his reindeer Sven, and snowman Olaf. On an adventure where she will find out what friendship, courage, family, and true love really means.

title: Vibe
overview: Two inseparable friends' ordinary, unassuming lives spiral into an unpredictable, high-energy adventure that pushes their survival instincts and friendship to the limit.

title: Drive
overview: Driver is a skilled Hollywood stuntman who moonlights as a getaway driver for criminals. Though he projects an icy exterior, lately he's been warming up to a pretty neighbor named Irene and her young son, Benicio. When Irene's husband gets out of jail, he enlists Driver's help in a million-dollar heist. The job goes horribly wrong, and Driver must risk his life to protect Irene and Benicio from the vengeful masterminds behind the robbery.

title: Falcon and canary
overview: Saqr falls in love with fashion designer Kanarya, but their love story becomes complicated due to complex family issues involving her sister and brother-in-law.

title: On My Behalf
overview: In a world where human messengers replace instant messaging, a messenger’s ordinary workday reveals the growing distance between people.

title: Land of No Man
overview: A loner capybara is questioned by passer-by animals: aren't you lonely?

title: Blue
overview: Luce, a bright young student from a good family, falls for Loris, a reckless boy whose debts put them both in danger. She turns to Vittoria, a once-familiar friend now living in luxury, who convinces her to use erotic sites to pay off the debt. But, like dominos, every part of her life starts collapsing. The two girls won't leave until dawn, once Luce's debt is paid, but at what cost?

title: Triple Threat
overview: Sexiness truly runs in the family. Get to know VMX A-listers and sisters Angela Morena, Stephanie Raz and Micaella Raz better – from their beginnings, their sisterly bond, to their most talked about scenes, they’re all out in this hot and fun special.

title: A Beautiful Mind
overview: From the heights of notoriety to the depths of depravity, John Forbes Nash Jr. experiences it all. As a brilliant but socially awkward mathematician, he made a groundbreaking discovery early in his career and stands on the brink of international acclaim. But as the handsome and arrogant Nash accepts secret work in cryptography, he becomes entangled in a mysterious conspiracy. His life takes a nightmarish turn and he soon finds himself on a painful and harrowing journey of self-discovery.

title: ZsaZsa Zaturnnah vs The Amazonistas of Planet X
original_title: ZsaZsa Zaturnnah vs The Amazonistas of Planet X
overview: Ada is a shy gay man living in a small town in the Philippines. After many heartbreaks over many years, he has committed himself to a simple and single life. But when a magical stone from outer space transforms him into a flamboyant female superhero, Ada is forced to face fantastic challenges. From fighting zombies to stopping invading Amazonistas from Planet X, to the even more difficult task of risking his heart to love again.

title: The Sound of the Jaguar
overview: Irma, a woman originally from an indigenous region in Mexico, migrates to the city. As she navigates the streets of this new environment, she engages in a dialogue with herself. With each word, memories of a past life in which Irma was a jaguar roaming the vast Chinantec region start to emerge.

title: The Comet
overview: Eight-year-old Émile is enjoying the last of the warm summer evenings with his sister Françoise. While they are eagerly scanning the night sky for shooting stars, they are suddenly interrupted by a despicably cruel act.

title: Dudley & the Invasion of the Space Slugs
original_title: Dudley & the Invasion of the Space Slugs
overview: Dudley is a teenage frog who lives a peaceful life by the edge of his pond with his friends, meanwhile his parents are worried about his future. But when aliens land on Earth, Dudley's world is thrown into chaos. What if he has what it takes to become a hero and save the whole of humanity?

title: The Next Karate Kid
overview: Twelve-year-old Sasha is forced to leave Moscow for Pyatigorsk to live with his aunt while his doctor parents are on assignment in Africa. Local children, school bullying, and conflict with the leader, Marat, become part of his new life. When his parents disappear during a flood, the boy faces utter despair. Seeking strength, he discovers a passion-karate, where his strict sensei, Dmitriy, and his daughter, Masha, help him overcome his fears, develop his character, and find inner strength.

title: Fingerbang
overview: Rejected by everyone, a woman follows a mysterious finger into a surreal realm, where a tender yet unsettling touch slowly begins to twist her reality.

title: A Trip to the Ear
overview: A woman, living in a house that drifts like cosmic debris, wakes to find her right ear and her husband gone. To recover what was lost, she embarks on a surreal journey through the void.

title: Misery
overview: After an accident, acclaimed novelist Paul Sheldon is rescued by a nurse who claims to be his biggest fan.  Her obsession takes a dark turn when she holds him captive in her remote Colorado home and forces him to write back to life the popular literary character he killed off.

title: The Orbit of Minor Satellites
overview: A dark story about love in a time of darkness that follows a psychiatric patient, the doctor who treats her, and the imagined inhabitants of a forgotten Cold War space station on a moon of Saturn.

title: Steppe Gods
overview: In the summer of 1945, between the Victory over Germany and the war with Japan, 10-year-old Petka from a Far Eastern village tries to save a dying friend from a mysterious illness. But the only one who can help him is the Japanese prisoner Hirotaro from a military camp nearby. Petka and Hirotaro will have to find a common language, trust each other and call for help not only science, but even ancient spirits.

title: Chinna Chinna Aasai
overview: On the enchanting shores of Varanasi, two souls meet by chance. Somewhere within this unfolding chaos, an unspoken bond begins to form, slowly slipping beyond friendship.

title: My Aunt
overview: Sunhee, who runs a modest animal clinic, is fostering a puppy whose owner never returned. Out of the blue, the niece she had raised as her own shows up after ten years, only to announce that she is leaving for New Zealand the very next day.

title: Deewana
overview: Munna, an ordinary boy in an ordinary world, sees a beauty that feels beyond his reach. While he struggles to become worthy of her, she is quietly learning to leave.

title: Where's the Respect?
overview: "Where’s the Respect?" is a track written, composed, and produced by Ali Boubacar Bonkano, featuring vocals by Bima Bama. Delivered as a raw, personal narrative from Bama’s perspective, the lyrics confront the persistent jealousy and scrutiny Bonkano faces within the fashion industry. By centering the recurring question, "Where's the respect?", the track critiques a competitive environment while asserting Bonkano’s dominance and refusal to be derailed. Ultimately, the song serves as a defiant declaration of focus, confirming that he will continue to advance his craft and legacy, indifferent to the negative opinions and insecurities of those waiting for his downfall.

title: You Are the Film
overview: The directorial debut of Makoto Ueda, the award-winning writer of such films as Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes, River, Night is Short Walk on Girl, etc

title: It's My Time
overview: Grandma Zhao Yanhong, whose mental state is "30 years ahead of her age," refuses to admit defeat, is fearless, and loves to cause trouble! After meeting the genius but ultimately useless Wu Youwei, who "would rather lie down than sit," she becomes involved with the Rubik's Cube, and together with her mentor, best friend, and family, stumbles and bravely ventures into the "Rubik's Cube world"! What kind of magic will she achieve after picking up a Rubik's Cube at 70? What bizarre opponents and chaotic unexpected events will she encounter...?

title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
overview: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

title: Mrs Winkler Leaves the House
overview: In 2030, retired actress Mrs. Winkler lives bitterly and marked by pain. When her daughter Emi accepts a theater offer, a care robot named Pavlovich takes over the care of her mother. Unexpectedly, his knowledge of classical plays seems to reawaken Mrs. Winkler's will to live...

title: Magical Secret Tour
original_title: マジカル・シークレット・ツアー
overview: A mother of two who suddenly learns of her husband’s embezzlement and crushing debts; a researcher buried in debt; and an unmarried, pregnant woman with no savings. Three women who seem to have nothing to do with crime cross paths by chance and, through gold smuggling, form an unexpected bond as partners in crime. As they seize money and freedom, a revenge game begins—one that allows each of them to reclaim and rebuild their lives. The sight of women who have long gone with the flow of life, choosing to take their fate into their own hands even if it means crossing the line into crime, shines with a dazzling intensity.

title: I Know Who You Are
overview: On 1949 October 1, the day of the founding ceremony of the People's Republic of China, Xiao Dali enters the city and is reorganized as the director of the public security police station. He finds that primary school teacher Feng Jingbo is full of doubts. With the high vigilance of a soldier and the sense of responsibility of a public security official, Dali insists on partnering with Feng and becomes his neighbor. He then spends his whole life carrying out a nearly four-decade pursuit without regrets.

title: Virtuous Women
overview: A VIP retreat for women seeking their best selves turns into an absurd and dangerous journey.

title: Unraveled
overview: Maria is a former elite swimmer and famous sports commentator whose life unravels when her beloved husband Mikael, her former coach and father of their daughter, is suddenly suspected of sexual abuse. Sparking the scandal and media interest is the revelation in an upcoming book, of a young girl’s misguided infatuation for her swimming coach, with rumors suggesting that Mikael is the man in question.

title: Dan Mintz: Well Rounded Entertainer
overview: Best known as the voice of Tina Belcher on Bob's Burgers, Dan Mintz began his career doing standup comedy, and is now releasing his first full-length special only 27 years later. Recorded live at Dynasty Typewriter in Los Angeles, Dan Mintz: Well Rounded Entertainer was then animated by the team behind Bob's Burgers, bringing to life Dan's deadpan one-liners with vivid colors and surreal animated bits.

title: The Day I Smoked a Cigarette with My Father
original_title: Le jour où j'ai fumé une cigarette avec mon père
overview: Cairo, 1964. Alaa, a 12-year-old boy, and his three younger siblings hear shouting from the street. Outside, the crowd is cheering for a man. The children can barely believe their eyes: the man is their father, Ibrahim.

title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
overview: When Dr. Indiana Jones – the tweed-suited professor who just happens to be a celebrated archaeologist – is hired by the government to locate the legendary Ark of the Covenant, he finds himself up against the entire Nazi regime.

title: Hanuman Ansh
overview: After the death of his mother, a young boy leaves his home in grief, believing that only by finding God can he meet her again. His search takes him across temples, forests, rivers and villages, where he lives in silence, discipline and devotion, slowly shedding all attachments. Through years of wandering and inner struggle, he discovers that God is not found in escape from the world, but in serving it. As his compassion grows, so do stories of quiet miracles, healing, and grace. Renouncing identity and ownership, the boy transforms into Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba, dedicating his life to feeding the hungry, loving all without distinction, and blessing humanity through humility, service and silent faith.

title: A House with a Breathing Fan
original_title: A House with a Breathing Fan
overview: After moving into his grandmother’s house, a Chinese-Indonesian teenager tries to replace an old fan that makes the house feel stuffy, unaware that it holds a family wound tied to the May 1998 tragedy.

title: Cantuta: La Orden Secreta
overview: A journalist receives a clandestine confession from a former agent of the Colina Group, who reveals the secrets behind the La Cantuta disappearances and the brutal war against terrorism that shook Peru in the 1990s.

title: Andy Lau “TODAY…is the Day” Hong Kong Concert Tour 2024/25
original_title: 刘德华《今天…is the Day》迴演唱會2024/2025 - 香港站
overview: This concert was professionally filmed for the Hong Kong show, as part of Andy Lau's most recent tour across 72 shows from 5th July 2024 to 10th January 2025

title: Anna is Still Reading for Delilah
original_title: Anna még mindig a Delilah szerepre készülődik
overview: An actor refuses to let her audition end until she gets the line just right.

title: Secret of Kalinga
overview: A college sits on ancient Kalinga kingdom land. Behind it, a forest well holds a princess's spirit, imprisoned centuries ago. Students accidentally break the seal on New Year's Eve, triggering comedic chaos.

title: Ibu, Bagaimana Aku Tanpamu?
overview: Plot under wraps. Based on a book with the same title.

title: Here the Whole Time
overview: An insecure teenager's vacation plans are ruined by an unexpected visitor: his neighbor and school crush who will spend two weeks sleeping at his house. The days that promised peace, tranquility and epic series marathons end up bringing a whirlwind of feelings and unresolved issues.

title: Checkout: The Movie
overview: The supermarket workers leave the sleepy supermarket in Yavneh for a crazy adventure in which they are accused of a serious crime in a plot that begins in a detention cell and countinues with an escape story of Shefa Isasschar in an attempt to save their good name.

title: Funky Freaky Freaks
overview: In a small city where redevelopment has stalled, three high school friends struggle with their own obsessions: Yong-gi, a self-styled "attention seeker" dreaming of becoming a superhero; Ji-sook, a "pro-ana" obsessed with losing her weight; and Dumbo, a "netkama" who scams money online by pretending to be a girl. Their fragile friendship unravels when Woo-joo, a charming transfer student and an influencer, shows up. Ji-sook falls for him instantly, while Yong-gi, who has been secretly in love with her, can only watch. But when Woo-joo's real self is revealed Ji-sook starts to collapse, Yong-gi's hidden feelings turn into a dangerous plan for revenge.

title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
original_title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
overview: Harry Potter's life is in danger once more as dangerous wizard Sirius Black has escaped from Azkaban Prison and is heading to Hogwarts.

title: Charlie Harper
overview: The journey of a young woman, Harper, and a young man, Charlie, as they meet, leave their respective homes, and attempt to build a life together in a new city. As the driven and ambitious Harper works to build a career as a chef, and the brilliant-yet-stuck Charlie struggles to get himself on track, their relationship faces growing challenges.

title: We Are Aliens
overview: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.

title: Crawlers
overview: When a man returns from a trip unwittingly harboring a new breed of arachnid, the people in an apartment block are quarantined and left to fend for themselves against a plague of venomous spiders.

title: After shift
overview: After the death of his wife Éva, László, a lonely warehouse worker, finds a way to return to the memories they once shared through a revolutionary VR technology. As he revisits moments of love, regret, and loss, he becomes consumed by the desire to rewrite the past and prevent the tragedy that separated them. But when the boundary between memory and reality disappears, László must finally accept that some things cannot be changed — only cherished, mourned, and released.

title: Pink & Blue
overview: After encountering a Creative Block, Jeff turns to Local Psychic Madam Vita to help him.

title: It's Nice to Finally Meet You
original_title: It's Nice to Finally Meet You
overview: It's Nice to Finally Meet You follows Hannah, a woman who is feeling anxious about meeting the parents. She feels like a failure in every aspect of her life, but she desperately wants to be accepted by this new family. It takes every ounce of courage for her to get to the front door. When she finally does, a surprise is in store for everyone involved. This film is a story about resilience and the power of gifts.

title: Cinco botones
overview: An anciet leyend is back to scare a group of history students

title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
overview: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

title: Armour of God
overview: Jackie Chan stars as Asian Hawk, an Indiana Jones-style adventurer looking to make a fortune in exotic antiquities. After Hawk discovers a mysterious sword in Africa, a band of Satan-worshipping monks kidnap his ex-girlfriend Lorelei, demanding the sword as ransom as well as other pieces of the legendary Armour of God - a magical outfit dating back to the Crusades.

title: Not to Be
overview: After the death of his father, Kiril realizes that one day he will die too. Searching for some meaning, he ventures into his memories, and they take him on a walk through his consciousness. Will his loved ones be able to rekindle his hope? Will he find a reason to love life again... and accept death?

title: Superego: 20th Anniversary Show
overview: Superego: profiles in self-obsession: celebrate the 20th anniversary of the popular and pioneering podcast live on stage — one night only!  Enter the world of the Superego Clinic for Analytical Pscience™ where doctors Matt Gourley, Jeremy Carter, Mark McConville, Paul F. Tompkins, and newest member of the staff, Andy Daly, present a curious batch of beloved characters and case studies — a gathering of self-absorbed swellheads, improvised and analyzed before your very eyes. A rare opportunity to see what can normally only be heard!  Enter the world of the Superego Clinic for Analytical Pscience™ where doctors Matt Gourley, Jeremy Carter, Mark McConville, Paul F. Tompkins, and newest member of the staff, Andy Daly, present a curious batch of beloved characters and case studies — a gathering of self-absorbed swellheads, improvised and analyzed before your very eyes. A rare opportunity to see what can normally only be heard!

title: Still Sexy
overview: Maddalena has it all: a job she loves, the perfect fiancé, and a dream wedding ahead. Yet in the bedroom, something feels wrong. Urged on by her inner voice, embodied by pornstar Valentina Nappi, she begins to question her life. Meeting Bruno, a gardener with a troubled past, leads her to rediscover herself and realize the only path worth following is her own.

title: Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear
overview: After surviving a devastating plane crash that nearly took his life, legendary and electrifying drummer Travis Barker embarks on a raw and redemptive journey. Once a trash collector in Laguna Beach, his life changed when he stepped in as a replacement for Blink-182’s drummer, igniting a meteoric rise that would make him the driving pulse of a generation. Yet beneath the spectacle of fame, the film reveals a complex man battling pain, grief and the thin line between survival and surrender. Featuring appearances from collaborators, cultural icons and those closest to him. This is the story of the man behind the tattoos. A tribute to those who keep going when the music almost stops.

title: Toy Story: 30 Years and Beyond - A Special Edition of 20/20
original_title: Toy Story: 30 Years and Beyond - A Special Edition of 20/20
overview: Exploring the 40-year legacy of Pixar through the lens of its innovative and wildly successful franchise "Toy Story"; Pixar Animation Studios in Emeryville, Calif.; interviews with original cast members.

title: The Doll
overview: Wealthy merchant Stanislaw Wokulski falls tragically in love with beautiful yet vain Izabela Lecka. His unfulfilled love leads to many foolish decisions sealing his fate.

title: Easter Eggs
overview: Nino needs to find money to buy a bus ticket to Paris. Today, She has a make-or-break interview for her right to stay in France. With her friend, she crosses the city, searching for a solution, because giving up...is not an option.

title: Rivals: Messi v Ronaldo
overview: As football entered a new era of global prominence, two players emerged who would redefine not just greatness but the sport itself. This film looks at two individuals who didn’t just dominate their era – they created one. For over a decade, their rivalry transcended clubs, countries and competitions, becoming the defining story of modern football – reshaping how the game was played, consumed and debated across the world.

title: Savage Mountain
overview: Kristin Harila risked everything to summit the world’s 14 highest peaks at record speed. When her final ascent sparked backlash, her greatest triumph became a reckoning.

title: Kijsada Paradise
original_title: กฤษดา พาราไดซ์
overview: A friend who goes missing in an abandoned amusement park sets the friendship of a group of teenagers to a challenge as they encounter conflict and secrets along the way.

title: Khadam
overview: Melor, who is forced to inherit her family's inheritance. As a result, she must race against time to save her daughter from a dark entity that is beginning to take over her life.

title: Honeyjoon
overview: Persian-Kurdish Lela and her American daughter June take a trip to the romantic Azores after a recent loss, both with polar opposite views about why they’re there, how to grieve, and the size of June’s tiny bikini. Amidst honeymooners, the Woman, Life, Freedom movement and their hot, philosophical tour guide, João, the pair find each other… coming back to life.

title: ママがもうこの世界にいなくても　私の命の日記
original_title: ママがもうこの世界にいなくても　私の命の日記
overview: A terminally ill woman chooses to have a child and spends her final days embracing motherhood with courage and love.

title: Hallowarrior
overview: Pumpkin, the last girl on earth and sole survivor of a humanity-ending plague, scavenging the wasteland for supplies on the eve of Halloween. Pumpkin’s lonely holiday ritual is interrupted by the arrival of a savage gang of raiders at her doorstep, led by the fearsome Thalia. Outnumbered and armed with candy, wit and weapons, Pumpkin must ferociously fight back to survive the night.

title: Wind River
overview: An FBI agent teams with the town's veteran game tracker to investigate a murder that occurred on a Native American reservation.

title: Shutter Island
overview: World War II soldier-turned-U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels investigates the disappearance of a patient from a hospital for the criminally insane, but his efforts are compromised by troubling visions and a mysterious doctor.

title: Sing Geetham
overview: In an isolated village, young Prathap seeks opportunity but enters a world of deception. Drawn into uncontrollable forces, he's caught between progress and preservation, testing his beliefs and purpose.

title: Ownerships
overview: Vera and Lucas, a frustrated couple in their forties, find a huge apartment at half the usual price thanks to a “bare ownership” deal: they buy it now, but the elderly owner will keep living there until he dies. What seemed like a miraculous opportunity soon turns into an obsession when Jesús disappears, reappears changed, and stops behaving like someone on his last legs. Caught between suspicion, frustration, and increasingly dark humor, the couple begins to consider a plan as absurd as it is tempting.

title: Sugar Mommy
overview: When a non-committal sugar mommy takes in her three sugar babies, jealousy erupts as one of them becomes determined to be her one and only.

title: Nobody's Son
overview: The script centres on Mathilda and Thomas, married for over 15 years. They’ve always dreamed of having children, but their efforts were only met with failures. After having adopted Mapring, a 4-year-old boy from Thailand, their life takes a tragic turn when Mathilda dies in an accident. Thomas then finds himself alone with a child he hadn’t really wanted. Devastated by this loss and incapable of forming a bond with Mapring, he decides to go look for the child’s biological family. Accompanied by Chaan, a local guide, Thomas starts on a trying journey through Thailand. Over time, father and son start to tame each other and create bonds… However, a crucial question remains: what will Thomas do when he finds Mapring’s biological family?

title: Ghost Rider
overview: In order to save his dying father, young stunt cyclist Johnny Blaze sells his soul to Mephistopheles and sadly parts from the pure-hearted Roxanne Simpson, the love of his life. Years later, Johnny's path crosses again with Roxanne, now a go-getting reporter, and also with Mephistopheles, who offers to release Johnny's soul if Johnny becomes the fabled, fiery 'Ghost Rider'.

overview: In the fourth part of the CarousHELL saga, Duke tries to help Robbie understand growing up isn't scary. On a father/son vacation to a cabin in the woods, Robbie finds the Nekkomeownicon and tries to speak to his late mother. But these words are instead heard by The Leviathan and its demon horde.

title: Deep sea exploration : the last frontiers on Earth
original_title: Abysses, la face cachée des océans
overview: In the deep ocean, where darkness reigns, scientists uncover a hidden world that sustains life on Earth. From extraordinary creatures to invisible microbial processes, the abysses play a crucial role in regulating the climate and ocean balance. But as the race for deep-sea minerals intensifies, this fragile ecosystem is under threat. A breathtaking journey into the largest, and least known, environment on our planet.

title: Gamechangers: The Ashlyn Harris Story
overview: Soccer champion and women’s sports advocate Ashlyn Harris is telling her full story for the first time ever, sharing her triumphs and defeats both on and off the soccer field, Ashlyn bares all, leaving viewers heartbroken at times and inspired at others.

title: Madagascar
overview: Four animal friends get a taste of the wild life when they break out of captivity at the Central Park Zoo and wash ashore on the island of Madagascar.

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
original_title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
overview: Joel Barish, heartbroken that his girlfriend underwent a procedure to erase him from her memory, decides to do the same. However, as he watches his memories of her fade away, he realises that he still loves her, and may be too late to correct his mistake.

title: The Gymnasts of Fisherman Colony
overview: The birth of a gymnastics team in Pakistan provides an inspiring spark of light for a small group of girls on the margins.

title: The Aura
overview: Claudia is an unlucky and fatalistic young woman. During an esoteric event in a bookstore, a disturbing apparition in an aura photo will turn her day and her friend Antonia’s upside down.

title: Summer House
overview: Selin travels back in time at a summer house and finds herself in her mother's youth, changing her family's fate and rebuilding her own life.

title: Lost in Translation
overview: Two lost souls visiting Tokyo -- the young, neglected wife of a photographer and a washed-up movie star shooting a TV commercial -- find an odd solace and pensive freedom to be real in each other's company, away from their lives in America.

title: Detective Chen 2
overview: In 1930s Shanghai, a wrongly accused hero escapes death row and unravels a deadly conspiracy, battling enemies and uncovering a foreign plot that threatens his nation.

title: Eyes Wide Shut
overview: After Dr. Bill Harford's wife, Alice, admits to having sexual fantasies about a man she met, Bill becomes obsessed with having a sexual encounter. He discovers an underground sexual group and attends one of their meetings -- and quickly discovers that he is in over his head.

title: Ducobu et le fantôme de Saint-Potache
original_title: Ducobu et le fantôme de Saint-Potache

title: Parimala and Co
overview: A dark comedy centered around a chaotic family whose tangled relationships and unpredictable situations lead to emotionally charged and absurd moments, blending humor with underlying tension and drama.

title: Yamaguchi-kun Isn't So Bad
original_title: 山口くんはワルくない

title: My Heaven, Your Hell
overview: Over the years, Adela and Victoria live an impossible love story and are strongly punished by the law and by the society of the 60's and 70's in Spain. However, despite all the impediments, they cannot forget each other.

original_title: The A-Word: The Future of Aging
overview: Modern medicine treats diseases one-by-one, but what if aging itself is the root cause? The A-Word: The Future of Aging follows visionary scientists racing to extend lifespan and the rescue dog whose bond with an 87-year-old widower demonstrates the stakes of life extension.

title: Leg Day
overview: To some, every day is leg day...

title: Bandar
overview: TV star Samar's life spirals when his ex Gayatri accuses him of rape after he blocks contact with her. Despite his new relationship with Khushi, he faces arrest and encounters a corrupt justice system.

title: Madfabulous
overview: When the flamboyant Henry Paget arrives in 1890s North Wales to claim his aristocratic inheritance, his theatrical flair and defiant eccentricities send shockwaves through the upper-class elite, much to the amusement of the local townspeople. Alongside his spirited cousin, Lily, and loyal butler, Gelert, Henry tries to carve out his own identity as the Fifth Marquess, navigating suffocating traditions, scheming relatives, and the long shadow cast by his estranged father.

title: Reol Oneman Live '美辞学' Bijigaku in YOKOHAMA ARENA
original_title: Reol Oneman Live '美辞学' Bijigaku in YOKOHAMA ARENA
